title: The visible score counter caps at the number shown at game start (score0/366) and I hit 366/366 mid-Marrowgate, well before finishing the Founding Ledger, the first Reeve's confession, and the Hollow Throne finale. Later discoveries still printed '(+N)' bonuses but the top-line score display stopped moving, which reads as 'nothing more to find' even though major content remained.
